# Chemotaxis III Lean companion

> Partial Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization of "Chemotaxis models with signal-dependent sensitivity and a logistic-type source, III: Bifurcation and spike-like solutions" (Le Chen, Ian Ruau, Wenxian Shen). Lake package chemotaxis-bifurcation-lean, release v0.1.1. v0.1.1 is a documentation release (arXiv v2 re-anchor, manuscript/ folder); the Lean source and the Lake package version 0.1.0 are unchanged since v0.1.0.

Public repository: https://github.com/chenle02/chemotaxis-paper-iii-lean
Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20976v2 (source and PDF in manuscript/)
Documentation site: https://chenle02.github.io/chemotaxis-paper-iii-lean/

Read README.md, docs/what-is-proved.md, docs/verification.md and data/public-scope-ledger.json before interpreting claims. Coverage is 47 verified scopes, 23 conditional scopes and 3 exclusions across 73 overlapping scopes, not a whole-paper correctness percentage. There are 1525 indexed public declarations including definitions. Whole PDE bifurcation, center manifolds, global alternatives/correspondence and stability are not certified. Supplied analytic family/jet/branch hypotheses remain explicit. Build with ./verify.sh; toolchain and dependency pins are immutable for a release. See LICENSE and CITATION.cff.

## Required context

- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chenle02/chemotaxis-paper-iii-lean/main/README.md): what is proved, not proved, build, trust and axioms; the marked block is generated by lean-pkg
- [docs/what-is-proved.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chenle02/chemotaxis-paper-iii-lean/main/docs/what-is-proved.md): result families, sign-off boundary, statement cards
- [docs/verification.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chenle02/chemotaxis-paper-iii-lean/main/docs/verification.md): generated page with every result's Lean statement and coverage class
- [data/public-scope-ledger.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chenle02/chemotaxis-paper-iii-lean/main/data/public-scope-ledger.json): authoritative scope text and boundaries

## Source and build

- [ChemotaxisBifurcation.lean](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chenle02/chemotaxis-paper-iii-lean/main/ChemotaxisBifurcation.lean): library root importing every module
- [verify.sh](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chenle02/chemotaxis-paper-iii-lean/main/verify.sh): cache restore, full build, owned-declaration axiom audit, negative control
- [lean-toolchain](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chenle02/chemotaxis-paper-iii-lean/main/lean-toolchain), [lake-manifest.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chenle02/chemotaxis-paper-iii-lean/main/lake-manifest.json): exact pins
- [claims.yaml](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chenle02/chemotaxis-paper-iii-lean/main/claims.yaml), [coverage.yaml](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chenle02/chemotaxis-paper-iii-lean/main/coverage.yaml): claim and coverage data behind the generated pages; do not edit generated output by hand

## Manuscript

- [manuscript/README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chenle02/chemotaxis-paper-iii-lean/main/manuscript/README.md): abstract, files, build and rights (the manuscript is not Apache-licensed)
- [manuscript/Chen-Ruau-Shen-JMB.tex](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chenle02/chemotaxis-paper-iii-lean/main/manuscript/Chen-Ruau-Shen-JMB.tex): arXiv v2 LaTeX source; theorems are stated in the Introduction
- [docs/manuscript-versions.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chenle02/chemotaxis-paper-iii-lean/main/docs/manuscript-versions.md): v1, October 20 and v2 compared
